goal: Kotlin review: nullability, coroutines, resource handling and serialisation.
use: Kotlin review: nullability, coroutines, resource handling and serialisation. Use when asked to review a Kotlin project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. The build file, the Kotlin version and the lint configuration.
Check nullability. Flag !! on values that can be null in practice.
Check coroutines. Flag blocking calls inside coroutines and unscoped launches.
Check resources. Streams and connections must close.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
